elements.text:
Breathe in through your nose for a count of four... 

hold for four... 

exhale for four... 

 and pause again for four. 

Picture each side of a square as you move through the cycle. 

[add image link https://www.navigatingcalm.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/In-for-4.png] 

Repeat a few times to help steady your mind and body.
